items.claim: Darren Elkins has taken too much cumulative damage and is too old to be fighting.
items.quote: This guy's taken damage. He's 42 and a half years old. He's 170 years old in fight years. Darren Elkins shouldn't be fighting.

items.claim: Ty Miller has a 4-inch height advantage and a 5-inch reach advantage over Billy Goff.
items.quote: he's going to have a 4-inch height advantage and he's going to have a 5-in reach advantage

items.claim: Ty Miller has very good takedown defense to stop Billy Goff's wrestling.
items.quote: Miller, who does seem to have very good takedown defense.

items.claim: Ty Miller has a fast jab, good volume, and good cardio.
items.quote: His jabs nasty. Good combinations. We'll mix it up to the head, to the body, good volume, good cardio.

items.claim: Billy Goff can be hurt and dropped, though he is very tough and durable.
items.quote: he can be hurt. He can be dropped. He's very tough though. You got to kind of kill him to get him out of there.

items.claim: Dr. Nurgay has good footwork, good speed, and some power.
items.quote: solid footwork, good speed for the division. He's got some power, good headkick.

items.claim: Dr. Nurgay's takedown defense is good enough to stuff Bruno Lopez's wrestling.
items.quote: I think his takedown defense is good enough to stuff the takedowns of Bruno Lopez because Bruno Lopez just can't wrestle.

items.claim: Bruno Lopez is very hitable and chinny on the feet.
items.quote: Lopez is just so hitable. He's so chinny and he's probably going to walk into something here and get knocked out.
